verdict.rationale: Ollama documents its own REST API for running and managing models, backed by a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec, Python/JS libraries, and a stated stability commitment. That covers the core model operations a user would otherwise do through the app or CLI. However, nothing in the evidence states or demonstrates that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, and some UI-surfaced features, such as connecting Apps on macOS, have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage for app-only features like Apps connections, and independent hands-on confirmation that every UI action is scriptable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
